messages.content: Predict a human participant's response in an anonymous, simultaneous one-shot two-person game. Each player chooses A or B. Payoffs (your euros, the other person's euros), with your action first, are A/A=(20,20), A/B=(2,32), B/A=(32,2), B/B=(8,8). You do not observe the other person's current action before answering. Do not communicate or look at other participants' materials. You were told that everyone in the room receives the same information. After responses, 20 participants from this class are selected at random and paired to determine their euro payouts from this matrix. The game is now actually played with possible payment, even if its initial description was hypothetical. Earlier self-reported perceptions below are your ratings, not changes to the objective payoff rules. Details of your other task response are not supplied here; do not infer whether it preceded this response. Predict the recorded human answer, not an optimal strategy. Output only your chosen A or B, without explanation.

The current task instructions say that two participants out of every50 are randomly selected for payment of game earnings. No actual partner transfer has been revealed. Output only a JSON array [L,U] of the two integer endpoints as text, without explanation; do not replace the interval by its midpoint.
